extModManifestBean.name: @name@
extModManifestBean.shortDesc: Zerg larva and inject analysis: missed larva, inject uptime, phase tables, benchmarks and multi-replay averages.
extModManifestBean.description:
Larva Seconds Lost shows how well you use your larva and injects as Zerg, for one replay or averaged over many replays.

  • Larva page (hub): Open Replay, Analyze Latest Replay and Multi Analysis. Every result opens as its own sub-page under Larva.
  • New replays open automatically: when Scelight detects a new replay with a Zerg player, it is analyzed in the background and added as a sub-page.
  • Larva timeline per hatchery: when larva sat at 3 (floating), inject uptime, and likely missed inject windows.
  • Phase table: Early, Mid, Late and End game columns with larva generated, larva missed, missed inject value and inject uptime.
  • Benchmarks: your larva generation and larva missed rates ranked against bands from higher-level games.
  • Multi analysis: pooled tables for All games, ZvP, ZvT and ZvZ for up to two tracked players, plus milestones (100 supply, 66 and 80 drones, 200 supply).
  • Updates: the module checks its home page for new versions and can install them for you (restart Scelight to use the new version).

Home page and install guide: https://minetonight.github.io/scelight/larva-seconds-lost/
Report problems: https://github.com/minetonight/LarvaSecondsLost-Scelight/issues (or Discord: scorpion_rbp)
